items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: Eddie Sauter was our first arranger with Red Norvo and Mildred Bailey.

ctx.x: What was, the recording at that time, probably consisted of one microphone or something?

Yeah. I had to leave my chair, because I played in a harmon mute with the stem pulled out, and I had to walk — so they left me eight bars out of the brass section to give me time to walk to the microphone, you know what I mean? And so I played into the mic and then I had to walk back and I had eight bars open to walk back and then take the mute out and join the section. Eddie Sauter was our first arranger with Red Norvo and Mildred Bailey. And before me he had played third trumpet in the band, like before the…
So you had decided by this time that I’m a musician and this is what I’m doing for the rest of my life?
